message.content: In the conversation recorded on 20261001_20:00, LiHua asks ThaneChambers if Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice is worth getting given his enthusiasm for challenging games. ThaneChambers responds positively, stating that "If you're into challenging games, you’ll love it." Furthermore, he mentions that the game's difficulty is intentional, saying "Just be ready for some tough battles! Definitely worth grabbing!" This clearly indicates that ThaneChambers does recommend Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice to those who enjoy a good challenge.
